subject: general
question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 8%, 17% and 17%. (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.

Successive multipliers for discounts: (100 − 8)% = 0.92, (100 − 17)% = 0.83, and (100 − 17)% = 0.83.

Effective Price % = 100 × 0.92 × 0.83 × 0.83.

Effective Price % = 92 × 0.6889 = 63.3788%.

Rounding up to two decimal places, we get 63.38%.

**∴ The correct answer is 63.38%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Three consecutive discounts of **8%**, **17%**, and **17%**.

**Formulas:** Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100) | Effective Price % = (SP ÷ MP) × 100.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c22978beb483727923401e5a5468daeb4eba0ea4af706ecf63d3631cdb99c9ca.png] 

⇒ Let MP = 100.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − (8% of 100) = 92.

⇒ Price after 2ⁿd discount = 92 − (17% of 92) = 92 − 15.64 = 76.36.

⇒ Price after 3rd discount = 76.36 − (17% of 76.36) = 76.36 − 12.9812 = 63.3788.

⇒ Effective price percentage = (63.3788 ÷ 100) × 100 = 63.3788%.

⇒ **Final Answer** = 63.38% (Rounded).

**∴ The correct answer is 63.38%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Discount vs Effective Price

Effective Price % is the final **Selling Price** as a percentage of MP, whereas Effective Discount % is (100 − Effective Price %).

Successive Discount Formula

For two discounts a% and b%, Net Discount = a + b − (ab ÷ 100). This can be applied iteratively for three discounts.</p
